en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ali Bin Is’haq Bin Sa’ad, from one of his companions,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the extent of the beard. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Clutch your beard by your hand, and cut whatever remains’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa‘d ibn Yunus from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The amount of beard that you must keep is what comes in inside your fist and you must clip off whatever exceeds you fist.’”
